en.headline: Cold front to cross Hong Kong later today, temperatures to fall to 15C
en.dek: The Observatory said the front over northern Guangdong will bring rain patches and cooler weather, with urban lows of 15 to 16 degrees on Friday and Saturday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a cold front now over the northern part of Guangdong is moving south and is expected to cross the coastal areas later on Wednesday.

Locally there will be one or two rain patches, with temperatures falling at night to about 21 degrees in urban areas and a couple of degrees lower in the New Territories. The weather will become appreciably cooler in the following days.

Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon, minimum temperatures are forecast around 15 to 16 degrees Celsius in urban areas on Friday and Saturday, with lower readings in the New Territories and colder conditions on high ground. The Observatory advised the public, especially those outdoors, to keep warm and look after the elderly and people with chronic conditions.

zh.headline: 冷鋒稍後橫過本港 周五六市區最低約15至16度
zh.dek: 天文台指廣東北部冷鋒今日稍後橫過沿岸，晚上氣溫下降至約21度，隨後顯著轉涼，高地風寒效應明顯。
body: 香港天文台表示，現時位於廣東北部的一道冷鋒正逐漸向南移動，預料會在今日稍後橫過沿岸地區。
本港會有一兩陣雨，晚上氣溫下降，市區最低約21度，新界再低兩三度。隨後一兩日天氣顯著轉涼。
受強烈東北季候風影響，星期五及星期六市區最低氣溫在15至16度左右，新界再低兩三度，初時高地風寒效應會較明顯及寒冷。天文台提醒市民留意天氣變化，注意保暖，並關顧長者及慢性病患者。
